Subject: Transient account lock after MFA enrollment - CedarPoint supplier portal

Hi Irene,

We just completed MFA enrollment for one of our supplier portal users and are seeing an intermittent account lock on first login after MFA is set up. The user follows the SSO link -> completes MFA -> gets redirected back to the portal and then receives a generic "Access denied (403) - transient account lock" message.

This is blocking PO approvals tonight. I've attached a screenshot (login_error.png) and a short SAML assertion capture (saml_assertion.txt). We are on Coupa for supplier onboarding (CedarPoint tenant).

User details:
- Name: Samuel Klein
- Email: s.klein@cedarpoint.com
- Local user id: ced-usr-4782
- Time of failure: 2027-05-29T08:58:12-07:00
- Browser: Chrome 112 on macOS 12.6

Workarounds we tried: incognito window, clearing cookies, different browser — all reproduce the same behavior.

Can Redwood do a session reset or push a one-time magic link so our user can finish onboarding? We need a root-cause if possible (is this an IdP assertion mismatch or cookie binding issue?).

Thanks,
Samantha Doe

Thanks all — I'm looping in with a short technical summary and the next steps we will take from the Redwood side.

TL;DR: Suspect SameSite cookie behavior combined with the MFA redirect is dropping the session binding during the post-auth SAML relay. This manifests as a transient account lock when the portal receives an assertion but cannot bind it to an active session.

Immediate actions (Irene/Ben):
- I'll issue a one-time sign-in link for s.klein@cedarpoint.com and push a tenant session TTL bump for 24 hours. Link will be sent to Samantha's email shortly.
- We'll enable a temporary session-reset hook for CedarPoint tenant while we run a replay of the assertion to validate NameID binding.
- I'll open SUP-12345 in JIRA to track the post-mortem and remediation (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-12345).

Longer-term remediation options:
- Adjust cookie SameSite flags for the tenant to 'None' + Secure for IdP flows that require cross-site redirects.
- Add a server-side rebind step: accept the assertion and create a short-lived session if the assertion is valid but session unavailable.

Laura — can you approve the 24-hour tenant exception and temporary session hook? If approved, we'll execute and notify Samantha with the one-time link.

Samantha — expected ETA for the one-time link: ~20 minutes once Laura approves. I will perform the assertion replay and send a short diagnostic log after the test.

Thanks,
